format: PNG, 64x64, transparent background, hand-painted classic fantasy style matching assets/backpack-icons/v1.0.0
integration: add the PNGs to the backpack icon atlas (tools/embed_backpack_icons.py) under these ids; the game picks a painted tile before the stand-in automatically
rules: original art only: do not copy Ultima Online or other copyrighted artwork

metal and hide pieces: paint a neutral base (steel grey, plain tan). The game marks the material with a colour chip on the icon; per-material recolouring of painted tiles is a later step (iron steel grey, copper reddish bronze, golden yellow, shadow iron dark charcoal, verite muted green, valorite blue-grey, mithril pale silver-blue)
one item per icon, centred, about 6 px margin, light from the top left
